name: Function.one_to_one_iff
statement:
theorem Function.one_to_one_iff {X Y: Set} (f: Function X Y) :
    f.one_to_one ↔ ∀ x x': X, f x = f x' → x = x'
proof:
:= by
  peel with x hx; tauto

name: Function.one_to_one_iff'
statement:
theorem Function.one_to_one_iff' {X Y: Set} (f: Function X Y) :
    f.one_to_one ↔ Function.Injective f.to_fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_to_one_iff, Function.Injective]

name: SetTheory.Set.f_3_3_18_one_to_one
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.f_3_3_18_one_to_one :
    (Function.mk_fn (fun (n:Nat) ↦ ((n^2:ℕ):Nat))).one_to_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.one_to_one_iff]
  intro _ _ h
  simpa [Function.eval, Function.eval_of] using h

name: SetTheory.Set.two_to_one
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.two_to_one {X Y: Set} {f: Function X Y} (h: ¬ f.one_to_one) :
    ∃ x x': X, x ≠ x' ∧ f x = f x'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.one_to_one] at h; aesop

name: Function.onto_iff
statement: theorem Function.onto_iff {X Y: Set} (f: Function X Y) : f.onto ↔ Function.Surjective f.to_fn
proof: := by rfl

name: Function.bijective_iff
statement:
theorem Function.bijective_iff {X Y: Set} (f: Function X Y) :
    f.bijective ↔ Function.Bijective f.to_fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.bijective, Function.Bijective, one_to_one_iff', onto_iff]

name: Function.bijective_incorrect_def
statement:
theorem Function.bijective_incorrect_def :
    ∃ X Y: Set, ∃ f: Function X Y, (∀ x: X, ∃! y: Y, y = f x) ∧ ¬ f.bijective
proof:
:= by
  use Nat, Nat
  set f := mk_fn fun x ↦ (0: Nat); use f
  constructor
  · intros
    apply existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique
    · use 0; rw [Function.eval]
    intros; rw [Function.eval] at *; aesop
  rw [Function.bijective]
  suffices h : ¬ f.one_to_one by tauto
  rw [Function.one_to_one_iff]
  push_neg; use 0, 1; simp [f]

name: Function.inverse_eval
statement:
theorem Function.inverse_eval {X Y: Set} {f: Function X Y} (h: f.bijective) (y: Y) (x: X) :
    x = (f.inverse h) y ↔ f x = y
proof: := Function.eval _ _ _

name: Function.inverse_eq
statement:
theorem Function.inverse_eq {X Y: Set} [Nonempty X] {f: Function X Y} (h: f.bijective) :
    (f.inverse h).to_fn = Function.invFun f.to_fn
proof:
:= by
  ext y; congr; symm
  rw [inverse_eval]
  apply Function.rightInverse_invFun (f.bijective_iff.mp h).2

name: PSet.ofNat_mem_ofNat_of_lt
statement: lemma PSet.ofNat_mem_ofNat_of_lt (m n : ℕ) : n < m → ofNat n ∈ ofNat m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | refl => rw [ofNat]; apply mem_insert
  | step _ ih => rw [ofNat]; exact mem_insert_of_mem _ ih

name: PSet.mem_ofNat_iff
statement: lemma PSet.mem_ofNat_iff (n m : ℕ) : ofNat n ∈ ofNat m ↔ n < m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ ?_, ofNat_mem_ofNat_of_lt m n ⟩
  contrapose!; rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq]; rintro (h|rfl)
  · exact mem_asymm (ofNat_mem_ofNat_of_lt _ _ h)
  apply mem_irrefl

name: PSet.eq_of_ofNat_equiv_ofNat
statement: lemma PSet.eq_of_ofNat_equiv_ofNat (n m : ℕ): (ofNat.{u} n).Equiv (ofNat.{u} m) → n = m
proof:
:= by
  wlog hmn : m ≤ n generalizing n m
  · intro heq; rw [this _ _ _ heq.symm]; order
  intro h; rw [Equiv.eq, Set.ext_iff] at h
  have : n ≤ m := by specialize h (ofNat m); simpa [mem_irrefl, mem_ofNat_iff] using h
  order

name: IsLocalMaxOn.iff
statement:
theorem IsLocalMaxOn.iff (X:Set ℝ) (f:ℝ → ℝ) (x₀:ℝ) :
  IsLocalMaxOn f X x₀ ↔
  ∃ δ > 0, IsMaxOn f (X ∩ .Ioo (x₀ - δ) (x₀ + δ)) x₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [isMaxOn_iff, IsLocalMaxOn, IsMaxFilter, nhdsWithin.eq_1, Filter.eventually_inf_principal,
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_lt_iff]
  peel 3; constructor <;> intro h _ _ _ <;> apply h <;> grind

name: IsLocalMinOn.iff
statement:
theorem IsLocalMinOn.iff (X:Set ℝ) (f:ℝ → ℝ) (x₀:ℝ) :
  IsLocalMinOn f X x₀ ↔
  ∃ δ > 0, IsMinOn f (X ∩ .Ioo (x₀ - δ) (x₀ + δ)) x₀
proof:

        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_lt_iff]
  peel 3; constructor <;> intro h _ _ _ <;> apply h <;> grind

name: UniformContinuousOn.iff
statement:
theorem UniformContinuousOn.iff (f: ℝ → ℝ) (X:Set ℝ) : UniformContinuousOn f X  ↔
  ∀ ε > (0:ℝ), ∃ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ x₀ ∈ X, ∀ x ∈ X, δ.Close x x₀ → ε.Close (f x) (f x₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff_le, Real.Close]
  grind

name: integ_of_monotone
statement:
theorem integ_of_monotone {a b:ℝ} {f:ℝ → ℝ} (hf: MonotoneOn f (Icc a b)) :
  IntegrableOn f (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases hab : 0 < b-a
  swap
  . apply (integ_on_subsingleton _).1; rw [←BoundedInterval.length_of_subsingleton]; aesop
  have hbound := BddOn.of_monotone hf
  set I := Icc a b
  have hab' : a ≤ b := by linarith
  have (ε:ℝ) (hε: 0 < ε) : upper_integral f I - lower_integral f I ≤ ((f b - f a) * (b-a)) *ε := by
    choose N hN using exists_nat_gt (1/ε)
    have hNpos : 0 < N := by rify; linarith [show 0 < 1/ε by positivity]
    set δ := (b-a)/N
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
    have hbeq : b = a + δ*N := by simp [δ]; field_simp; linarith
    set e : ℕ ↪ BoundedInterval := {
      toFun j := Ico (a + δ*j) (a + δ*(j+1))
      inj' j k hjk := by simp at hjk; obtain _ | _ := hjk <;> linarith
    }
    set P : Partition I := {
      intervals := insert (Icc b b) (.map e (.range N))
      exists_unique := by
        intro x hx; simp; by_cases hb: x = b
        . apply ExistsUnique.intro (Icc b b)
          . simp [hb, mem_iff]
          rintro J ⟨ rfl | ⟨ j, hA, rfl ⟩, hJb ⟩; rfl
          simp [e, mem_iff, hb, hbeq] at hJb
          replace hJb := hJb.2
          rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left hδpos] at hJb
          norm_cast at hJb; linarith
        simp [I, mem_iff] at hx
        set j := ⌊ (x-a)/δ ⌋₊
        have hxa : 0 ≤ x-a := by linarith
        have hxaδ : 0 ≤ (x-a)/δ := by positivity
        have hxb : x < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hx.2 hb
        have hxj : x ∈ e j := by
          simp [e, mem_iff, j]; split_ands
          . calc
              _ ≤ a + δ * ((x-a)/δ) := by gcongr; grind [Nat.floor_le]
              _ = x := by grind
          calc
            _ = a + δ * ((x-a)/δ) := by field_simp; linarith
            _ < _ := by gcongr; apply Nat.lt_floor_add_one
        apply ExistsUnique.intro (e j)
        . refine ⟨ ?_, hxj ⟩; right; use j; simp [j, Nat.floor_lt hxaδ, div_lt_iff₀' hδpos]; linarith
        rintro J ⟨ rfl | ⟨ k, hk, rfl ⟩, hxJ ⟩
        . simp [mem_iff] at hxJ; grind
        simp [mem_iff, e] at hxJ hxj
        obtain hjk | rfl | hjk := lt_trichotomy j k
        . replace hjk : δ*((j:ℝ)+1) ≤ δ*(k:ℝ) := by rw [mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hδpos]; norm_cast
          linarith
        . rfl
        replace hjk : δ*((k:ℝ)+1) ≤ δ*(j:ℝ) := by rw [mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hδpos]; norm_cast
        linarith
      contains J hJ := by
        simp at hJ; obtain rfl | ⟨ j, hj, rfl ⟩ := hJ <;> simp [subset_iff, e, I]
        . linarith
        apply Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self.trans (Set.Icc_subset_Icc _ _)
        . simp; positivity
        simp [hbeq]; gcongr; norm_cast
    }
    have hup := calc
      upper_integral f I ≤ ∑ J ∈ P.intervals, (sSup (f '' (J:Set ℝ))) * |J|ₗ := upper_integ_le_upper_sum hbound P
      _ = ∑ j ∈ .range N, (sSup (f '' (Ico (a + δ*j) (a + δ*(j+1))))) * |Ico (a + δ*j) (a + δ*(j+1))|ₗ := by simp [P]; congr
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ .range N, f (a + δ*(j+1)) * δ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
        convert (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hδpos).mpr ?_
        . simp [length]; ring_nf; simp [le_of_lt hδpos]
        apply csSup_le
        . simp; grind
        intro y hy; simp at hy; obtain ⟨ x, ⟨ hx1, hx2 ⟩, rfl ⟩ := hy
        have : a + δ*(j+1) ≤ b := by simp [hbeq]; gcongr; norm_cast; grind
        have hδj : 0 ≤ δ*j := by positivity
        have hδj1 : 0 ≤ δ*(j+1) := by positivity
        apply hf _ _ (by order) <;> simp [I, hδj1, this]; grind
    have hdown := calc
      lower_integral f I ≥ ∑ J ∈ P.intervals, (sInf (f '' (J:Set ℝ))) * |J|ₗ :=
        lower_integ_ge_lower_sum hbound P
      _ = ∑ j ∈ .range N, (sInf (f '' (Ico (a + δ*j) (a + δ*(j+1))))) * |Ico (a + δ*j) (a + δ*(j+1))|ₗ := by simp [P]; congr
      _ ≥ ∑ j ∈ .range N, f (a + δ*j) * δ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
        convert (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hδpos).mpr ?_
        . simp [length]; ring_nf; simp [le_of_lt hδpos]
        apply le_csInf
        . simp; grind
        intro y hy; simp at hy; obtain ⟨ x, ⟨ hx1, hx2 ⟩, rfl ⟩ := hy
        have hajb': a + δ*(j+1) ≤ b := by simp [hbeq]; gcongr; norm_cast; grind
        have hδj : 0 ≤ δ*j := by positivity
        have hδj1 : 0 ≤ δ*(j+1) := by positivity
        apply_rules [hf] <;> simp [I, hδj] <;> grind
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ .range N, f (a + δ*(j+1)) * δ - ∑ j ∈ .range N, f (a + δ*j) * δ := by linarith
      _ = (f b - f a) * δ := by
        rw [←Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        have := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n ↦ f (a + δ*n) * δ) N
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at this
        convert this using 1; simp [hbeq]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have : 0 ≤ f b - f a := by simp; apply hf <;> simp [I, hab']
        simp [mul_assoc, δ]; gcongr
        rw [div_le_iff₀', mul_comm, mul_assoc]
        nth_rewrite 1 [←mul_one (b-a)]
        gcongr; rw [←div_le_iff₀']; linarith
        all_goals positivity
  refine ⟨ hbound, ?_ ⟩
  observe low_le_up : lower_integral f I ≤ upper_integral f I
  linarith [nonneg_of_le_const_mul_eps this]

name: integ_of_antitone
statement:
theorem integ_of_antitone {a b:ℝ} {f:ℝ → ℝ} (hf: AntitoneOn f (Icc a b)) :
  IntegrableOn f (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←neg_neg f]; apply (integ_of_monotone _).neg.1; convert hf.neg using 1

name: not_integrable
statement: theorem not_integrable : BddOn f_9_3_21 (Icc 0 1) ∧ ¬ IntegrableOn f_9_3_21 (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbdd: BddOn f_9_3_21 (Icc 0 1):= by
    use 1; intro x _; by_cases h: ∃ y:ℚ, y = x <;> simp [f_9_3_21, h]
  refine ⟨ hbdd, ?_ ⟩
  have hsup (P: Partition (Icc 0 1)) : ∀ J ∈ P.intervals, (sSup (f_9_3_21 '' (J:Set ℝ))) * |J|ₗ = |J|ₗ := by
    intro J hJ; by_cases hJ0: |J|ₗ = 0
    . simp [hJ0]
    have hJ0' := hJ0
    rw [←length_of_subsingleton] at hJ0
    convert (one_mul _)
    apply le_antisymm
    . apply csSup_le
      . contrapose! hJ0; simp_all
      grind
    apply le_csSup_of_le _ _ (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
    . rw [bddAbove_def]; use 1; grind
    simp at hJ0'; choose z hz hz' using Dense.exists_between (Rat.denseRange_cast (𝕜 := ℝ)) hJ0'
    simp at *; obtain ⟨ q, rfl ⟩ := hz
    have hq_mem : (q:ℝ) ∈ (J:Set ℝ) := (subset_iff _ _).mp (Ioo_subset J) (by simp [hz'])
    exact ⟨q, hq_mem⟩
  have hupper (P: Partition (Icc 0 1)) : upper_riemann_sum f_9_3_21 P = 1 := by
    simp [upper_riemann_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ J ∈ P.intervals, |J|ₗ := by apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; grind
      _ = _ := by simp [Partition.sum_of_length _ P]
  replace hupper : upper_integral f_9_3_21 (Icc 0 1) = 1 := by
    simp [upper_integ_eq_inf_upper_sum hbdd, hupper]
  have hinf (P: Partition (Icc 0 1)) : ∀ J ∈ P.intervals, (sInf (f_9_3_21 '' (J:Set ℝ))) * |J|ₗ = 0 := by
    intro J hJ; by_cases hJ0: |J|ₗ = 0
    . simp [hJ0]
    have hJ0' := hJ0
    rw [←length_of_subsingleton] at hJ0
    convert (zero_mul _)
    apply le_antisymm
    . apply csInf_le_of_le _ _ (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num)
      . rw [bddBelow_def]; use 0; grind
      simp at hJ0'
      choose z hz hz' using Dense.exists_between dense_irrational hJ0'
      simp at *
      refine ⟨ z, (subset_iff _ _).mp (Ioo_subset J) (by simp [hz']), ?_ ⟩
      intro q; contrapose! hz; simp [←hz]
    apply le_csInf
    . contrapose! hJ0; simp_all
    grind
  have hlower (P: Partition (Icc 0 1)) : lower_riemann_sum f_9_3_21 P = 0 := by
    simp [lower_riemann_sum]; calc
      _ = ∑ J ∈ P.intervals, (0:ℝ) := by apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; grind
      _ = _ := by simp
  replace hlower : lower_integral f_9_3_21 (Icc 0 1) = 0 := by
    simp [lower_integ_eq_sup_lower_sum hbdd, hlower]
  grind

name: MonotoneOn.iff
statement: theorem MonotoneOn.iff {X: Set ℝ} (f: ℝ → ℝ) : MonotoneOn f X  ↔ ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, y > x → f y ≥ f x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intros; solve_by_elim [le_of_lt]
  intro _ _ _ _ _ hxy; obtain hxy | rfl := le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hxy
  . solve_by_elim
  simp

name: StrictMono.iff

proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intros <;> solve_by_elim

name: AntitoneOn.iff
statement: theorem AntitoneOn.iff {X: Set ℝ} (f: ℝ → ℝ) : AntitoneOn f X  ↔ ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, y > x → f y ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intros; solve_by_elim [le_of_lt]
  intro _ _ _ _ _ hxy; obtain hxy | rfl := le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hxy
  . solve_by_elim
  simp

name: StrictAntitone.iff
statement: theorem StrictAntitone.iff {X: Set ℝ} (f: ℝ → ℝ) : StrictAntiOn f X  ↔ ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, y > x → f y < f x
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intros <;> solve_by_elim

name: Russells_paradox
statement: theorem Russells_paradox : ¬ axiom_of_universal_specification
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  set P : Object → Prop := fun x ↦ ∃ X:Set, x = X ∧ x ∉ X
  choose Ω hΩ using h P
  by_cases h: (Ω:Object) ∈ Ω
  . have : P (Ω:Object) := (hΩ _).mp h
    obtain ⟨ Ω', ⟨ hΩ1, hΩ2⟩ ⟩ := this
    simp at hΩ1
    rw [←hΩ1] at hΩ2
    contradiction
  have : P (Ω:Object) := by use Ω
  rw [←hΩ] at this
  contradiction

name: SetTheory.Set.axiom_of_regularity
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.axiom_of_regularity {A:Set} (h: A ≠ ∅) :
    ∃ x:A, ∀ S:Set, x.val = S → Disjoint S A
proof:
:= by
  choose x h h' using regularity_axiom A (nonempty_def h)
  use ⟨x, h⟩
  intro S hS; specialize h' S hS
  rw [disjoint_iff, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  contrapose! h'; simp at h'
  aesop

name: Series.root_test_pos
statement:
theorem Series.root_test_pos {s : Series}
  (h : atTop.limsup (fun n ↦ ((|s.seq n|^(1/(n:ℝ)):ℝ):EReal)) < 1) : s.absConverges
proof:
:= by
    
    set α':EReal := atTop.limsup (fun n ↦ ↑(|s.seq n|^(1/(n:ℝ)):ℝ))
    have hpos : 0 ≤ α' := by
      apply le_limsup_of_frequently_le (Frequently.of_forall _) (by isBoundedDefault)
      intros; positivity
    set α := α'.toReal
    have hαα' : α' = α := by
      symm; apply coe_toReal
      . contrapose! h; simp [h]; exact le_top
      contrapose! hpos; simp [hpos]
    rw [hαα'] at h hpos; norm_cast at h hpos
    set ε := (1-α)/2
    have hε : 0 < ε := by simp [ε]; linarith
    have hε' : α' < (α+ε:ℝ) := by rw [hαα', EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]; linarith
    have hα : α + ε < 1 := by simp [ε]; linarith
    have hα' : 0 < α + ε := by linarith
    have := eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt hε' (by isBoundedDefault)
    rw [eventually_atTop] at this
    choose N' hN using this; set N := max N' (max s.m 1)
    have (n:ℤ) (hn: n ≥ N) : |s.seq n| ≤ (α + ε)^n := by
      have : n ≥ N' := by omega
      have npos : 0 < n := by omega
      specialize hN n this
      rw [EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff] at hN
      calc
        _ = (|s.seq n|^(1/(n:ℝ)))^n := by
          rw [←rpow_intCast, ←rpow_mul (by positivity)]
          symm; convert rpow_one _; field_simp
        _ ≤ _ := by
          convert pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (le_of_lt hN) n.toNat
          all_goals convert zpow_natCast _ _; omega
    set k := (N - s.m).toNat
    have hNk : N = s.m + k := by omega
    have hgeom : (fun n ↦ (α+ε) ^ n : Series).converges := by
      simp [converges_geom_iff, abs_of_pos hα', hα]
    rw [converges_from _ N.toNat] at hgeom
    have : (s.from N).absConverges := by
      apply (converges_of_le _ _ hgeom).1
      . simp; omega
      intro n hn; simp at hn
      have hn' : n ≥ 0 := by omega
      simp [hn.1, hn.2, hn']
      convert this n hn.2; symm; convert zpow_natCast _ _; omega
    unfold absConverges at this ⊢
    rw [converges_from _ k]; convert this; simp; refine ⟨ by omega, ?_ ⟩
    ext n
    by_cases hnm : n ≥ s.m <;> simp [hnm]
    by_cases hn: n ≥ N <;> simp [hn] <;> grind

name: Series.root_test_neg
statement:
theorem Series.root_test_neg {s : Series}
  (h : atTop.limsup (fun n ↦ ((|s.seq n|^(1/(n:ℝ)):ℝ):EReal)) > 1) : s.diverges
proof:
:= by
    
    apply frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup (by isBoundedDefault) at h
    apply diverges_of_nodecay
    by_contra this; rw [LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.tendsto_nhds] at this; specialize this 1 (by positivity)
    choose n hn hs hs' using (h.and_eventually this).forall_exists_of_atTop 1
    simp at hs'; replace hs' := rpow_lt_one ?_ hs' (?_:0 < 1/(n:ℝ)) <;> try positivity
    rw [show (1:EReal) = (1:ℝ) by simp, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff] at hs
    linarith

name: Series.ratio_test_pos
statement:
theorem Series.ratio_test_pos {s : Series} (hnon: ∀ n ≥ s.m, s.seq n ≠ 0)
  (h : atTop.limsup (fun n ↦ ((|s.seq (n+1)| / |s.seq n|:ℝ):EReal)) < 1) : s.absConverges
proof:
:= by
    apply Series.root_test_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt _ h)
    convert (ratio_ineq s.m _).2.2
    convert hnon using 1 with n
    simp

name: Series.ratio_test_neg
statement:
theorem Series.ratio_test_neg {s : Series} (hnon: ∀ n ≥ s.m, s.seq n ≠ 0)
  (h : atTop.liminf (fun n ↦ ((|s.seq (n+1)| / |s.seq n|:ℝ):EReal)) > 1) : s.diverges
proof:
:= by
    apply Series.root_test_neg (lt_of_lt_of_le h _)
    convert (ratio_ineq s.m _).1.trans (ratio_ineq s.m _).2.1 with n; rfl
    all_goals convert hnon using 1 with n; simp

statement:
@[simp]

name: Real.steady_def
statement:
lemma Real.steady_def (ε: ℝ) (a: Chapter6.Sequence) :
  ε.Steady a ↔ ∀ n ≥ a.m, ∀ m ≥ a.m, ε.Close (a n) (a m)
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.eventuallySteady_def
statement:
lemma Real.eventuallySteady_def (ε: ℝ) (a: Chapter6.Sequence) :
  ε.EventuallySteady a ↔ ∃ N, (N ≥ a.m) ∧ ε.Steady (a.from N)
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.Steady.mono
statement:
theorem Real.Steady.mono {a: Chapter6.Sequence} {ε₁ ε₂: ℝ} (hε: ε₁ ≤ ε₂) (hsteady: ε₁.Steady a) :
    ε₂.Steady a
proof: := by grind

name: Real.EventuallySteady.mono

name: Sequence.isCauchy_def
statement:
lemma Sequence.isCauchy_def (a:Sequence) :
  a.IsCauchy ↔ ∀ ε > (0:ℝ), ε.EventuallySteady a
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.IsCauchy.coe
statement:
lemma Sequence.IsCauchy.coe (a:ℕ → ℝ) :
    (a:Sequence).IsCauchy ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ j ≥ N, ∀ k ≥ N, dist (a j) (a k) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  peel with ε hε
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ N, hN, h' ⟩
    lift N to ℕ using hN; use N
    intro j hj k hk
    simp [Real.steady_def] at h'
    specialize h' j ?_ k ?_ <;> try omega
    simp_all
  rintro ⟨ N, h' ⟩; refine ⟨ max N 0, by simp, ?_ ⟩
  intro n hn m hm; simp at hn hm
  have npos : 0 ≤ n := by omega
  have mpos : 0 ≤ m := by omega
  simp [hn, hm, npos, mpos]
  lift n to ℕ using npos
  lift m to ℕ using mpos
  specialize h' n ?_ m ?_ <;> try grind

name: Sequence.IsCauchy.mk
statement:
lemma Sequence.IsCauchy.mk {n₀:ℤ} (a: {n // n ≥ n₀} → ℝ) :
    (mk' n₀ a).IsCauchy
    ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N ≥ n₀, ∀ j ≥ N, ∀ k ≥ N, dist (mk' n₀ a j) (mk' n₀ a k) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  peel with ε hε
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ N, hN, h' ⟩; refine ⟨ N, hN, ?_ ⟩
    dsimp at hN
    intro j hj k hk
    simp only [Real.Steady, show max n₀ N = N by omega] at h'
    specialize h' j ?_ k ?_ <;> try omega
    simp_all [show n₀ ≤ j by omega, show n₀ ≤ k by omega]
  rintro ⟨ N, _, _ ⟩; use max n₀ N; grind

name: Chapter5.coe_sequence_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Chapter5.coe_sequence_eval (a: Chapter5.Sequence) (n:ℤ) : (a:Sequence) n = (a n:ℝ)

name: Sequence.isCauchy_of_rat
statement: theorem Sequence.isCauchy_of_rat (a: Chapter5.Sequence) : a.IsCauchy ↔ (a:Sequence).IsCauchy
proof:
:= by
  
  constructor
  swap
  . intro h; rw [isCauchy_def] at h
    rw [Chapter5.Sequence.isCauchy_def]
    intro ε hε
    specialize h ε (by positivity)
    rwa [is_eventuallySteady_of_rat]
  intro h
  rw [Chapter5.Sequence.isCauchy_def] at h
  rw [isCauchy_def]
  intro ε hε
  choose ε' hε' hlt using exists_pos_rat_lt hε
  specialize h ε' hε'
  rw [is_eventuallySteady_of_rat] at h
  exact h.mono (le_of_lt hlt)

name: Real.closeSeq_def
statement:
theorem Real.closeSeq_def (ε: ℝ) (a: Chapter6.Sequence) (L:ℝ) :
  ε.CloseSeq a L ↔ ∀ n ≥ a.m, dist (a n) L ≤ ε
proof: := by rfl

  ε.EventuallyClose a L ↔ ∃ N, (N ≥ a.m) ∧ ε.CloseSeq (a.from N) L

name: Real.CloseSeq.coe
statement:
theorem Real.CloseSeq.coe (ε : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ):
  (ε.CloseSeq a L) ↔ ∀ n, dist (a n) L ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro h n; specialize h n; grind
  . intro h n hn; lift n to ℕ using (by omega); specialize h n; grind

name: Real.CloseSeq.mono
statement:
theorem Real.CloseSeq.mono {a: Chapter6.Sequence} {ε₁ ε₂ L: ℝ} (hε: ε₁ ≤ ε₂)
  (hclose: ε₁.CloseSeq a L) :
    ε₂.CloseSeq a L
proof: := by peel 2 hclose; rw [Real.Close, Real.dist_eq] at *; linarith

name: Real.EventuallyClose.mono
statement:
theorem Real.EventuallyClose.mono {a: Chapter6.Sequence} {ε₁ ε₂ L: ℝ} (hε: ε₁ ≤ ε₂)
  (hclose: ε₁.EventuallyClose a L) :
    ε₂.EventuallyClose a L
proof: := by peel 2 hclose; grind [CloseSeq.mono]

name: Sequence.tendsTo_def
statement:
theorem Sequence.tendsTo_def (a:Sequence) (L:ℝ) :
  a.TendsTo L ↔ ∀ ε > (0:ℝ), ε.EventuallyClose a L
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.tendsTo_unique
statement:
theorem Sequence.tendsTo_unique (a:Sequence) {L L':ℝ} (h:L ≠ L') :
    ¬ (a.TendsTo L ∧ a.TendsTo L')
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra this
  choose hL hL' using this
  replace h : L - L' ≠ 0 := by grind
  replace h : |L-L'| > 0 := by positivity
  set ε := |L-L'| / 3
  have hε : ε > 0 := by positivity
  rw [tendsTo_iff] at hL hL'
  specialize hL ε hε; choose N hN using hL
  specialize hL' ε hε; choose M hM using hL'
  set n := max N M
  specialize hN n (by omega)
  specialize hM n (by omega)
  have : |L-L'| ≤ 2 * |L-L'|/3 := calc
    _ = dist L L' := by rw [Real.dist_eq]
    _ ≤ dist L (a.seq n) + dist (a.seq n) L' := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ ε + ε := by rw [←Real.dist_eq] at hN hM; rw [dist_comm] at hN; gcongr
    _ = 2 * |L-L'|/3 := by grind
  linarith

name: Sequence.convergent_def
statement: theorem Sequence.convergent_def (a:Sequence) : a.Convergent ↔ ∃ L, a.TendsTo L
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.divergent_def
statement: theorem Sequence.divergent_def (a:Sequence) : a.Divergent ↔ ¬ a.Convergent
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.lim_def
statement: theorem Sequence.lim_def {a:Sequence} (h: a.Convergent) : a.TendsTo (lim a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lim, h]; exact h.choose_spec

name: Sequence.lim_eq
statement:
theorem Sequence.lim_eq {a:Sequence} {L:ℝ} :
a.TendsTo L ↔ a.Convergent ∧ lim a = L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro h; by_contra! eq
    have : a.Convergent := by rw [convergent_def]; use L
    replace eq := a.tendsTo_unique (eq this)
    apply lim_def at this; tauto
  intro ⟨ h, rfl ⟩; convert lim_def h

name: Sequence.lim_harmonic
statement:
theorem Sequence.lim_harmonic :
    ((fun (n:ℕ) ↦ (n+1:ℝ)⁻¹):Sequence).Convergent ∧ lim ((fun (n:ℕ) ↦ (n+1:ℝ)⁻¹):Sequence) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [←lim_eq, tendsTo_iff]
  intro ε hε
  choose N hN using exists_int_gt (1 / ε); use N; intro n hn
  have hNpos : (N:ℝ) > 0 := by apply LT.lt.trans _ hN; positivity
  simp at hNpos
  have hnpos : n ≥ 0 := by linarith
  simp [hnpos, abs_inv]
  calc
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [inv_le_inv₀] <;> try positivity
      calc
        _ ≤ (n:ℝ) := by simp [hn]
        _ = (n.toNat:ℤ) := by simp [hnpos]
        _ = n.toNat := rfl
        _ ≤ (n.toNat:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
        _ ≤ _ := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ε := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀] <;> try positivity
      rw [←inv_eq_one_div _] at hN; order

name: Sequence.boundedBy_def
statement:
lemma Sequence.boundedBy_def (a:Sequence) (M:ℝ) :
  a.BoundedBy M ↔ ∀ n, |a n| ≤ M
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.isBounded_def
statement:
lemma Sequence.isBounded_def (a:Sequence) :
  a.IsBounded ↔ ∃ M ≥ 0, a.BoundedBy M
proof: := by rfl

name: Sequence.add_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Sequence.add_eval {a b: Sequence} (n:ℤ) : (a + b) n = a n + b n
proof: := rfl

name: Sequence.add_coe
statement: theorem Sequence.add_coe (a b: ℕ → ℝ) : (a:Sequence) + (b:Sequence) = (fun n ↦ a n + b n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rfl
  by_cases h:n ≥ 0 <;> simp [h]

name: Sequence.mul_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Sequence.mul_eval {a b: Sequence} (n:ℤ) : (a * b) n = a n * b n
proof: := rfl

name: Sequence.mul_coe
statement: theorem Sequence.mul_coe (a b: ℕ → ℝ) : (a:Sequence) * (b:Sequence) = (fun n ↦ a n * b n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rfl

name: boundedAwayPos_def
statement: theorem boundedAwayPos_def (a:ℕ → ℚ) : BoundedAwayPos a ↔ ∃ (c:ℚ), c > 0 ∧ ∀ n, a n ≥ c
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: boundedAwayNeg_def
statement: theorem boundedAwayNeg_def (a:ℕ → ℚ) : BoundedAwayNeg a ↔ ∃ (c:ℚ), c > 0 ∧ ∀ n, a n ≤ -c
proof:
:= by

name: BoundedAwayZero.boundedAwayPos
statement: theorem BoundedAwayZero.boundedAwayPos {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: BoundedAwayPos a) : BoundedAwayZero a
proof:
:= by
  peel 3 ha with c h1 n h2; rwa [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]

name: BoundedAwayZero.boundedAwayNeg
statement: theorem BoundedAwayZero.boundedAwayNeg {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: BoundedAwayNeg a) : BoundedAwayZero a

name: not_boundedAwayPos_boundedAwayNeg
statement: theorem not_boundedAwayPos_boundedAwayNeg {a:ℕ → ℚ} : ¬ (BoundedAwayPos a ∧ BoundedAwayNeg a)

:= by
  intro ⟨ ⟨ _, _, h2⟩ , ⟨ _, _, h4 ⟩ ⟩; linarith [h2 0, h4 0]

name: Real.isPos_def
statement:
theorem Real.isPos_def (x:Real) :
    IsPos x ↔ ∃ a:ℕ → ℚ, BoundedAwayPos a ∧ (a:Sequence).IsCauchy ∧ x = LIM a
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.isNeg_def
statement:
theorem Real.isNeg_def (x:Real) :
    IsNeg x ↔ ∃ a:ℕ → ℚ, BoundedAwayNeg a ∧ (a:Sequence).IsCauchy ∧ x = LIM a
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.nonzero_of_pos
statement: theorem Real.nonzero_of_pos {x:Real} (hx: x.IsPos) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := not_zero_pos x
  simpa [hx] using this

name: Real.nonzero_of_neg
statement: theorem Real.nonzero_of_neg {x:Real} (hx: x.IsNeg) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := not_zero_neg x

name: Real.abs_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.abs_of_pos (x:Real) (hx: x.IsPos) : abs x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [abs, hx]

name: Real.abs_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.abs_of_neg (x:Real) (hx: x.IsNeg) : abs x = -x
proof:
:= by
  have : ¬x.IsPos := by have := not_pos_neg x; simpa [hx] using this
  simp [abs, hx, this]

name: Real.abs_of_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.abs_of_zero : abs 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos: ¬(0:Real).IsPos := by have := not_zero_pos 0; simpa using this
  have hneg: ¬(0:Real).IsNeg := by have := not_zero_neg 0; simpa using this
  simp [abs, hpos, hneg]

name: Real.lt_iff
statement: theorem Real.lt_iff (x y:Real) : x < y ↔ (x-y).IsNeg
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.le_iff
statement: theorem Real.le_iff (x y:Real) : x ≤ y ↔ (x < y) ∨ (x = y)
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.gt_of_coe
statement: theorem Real.gt_of_coe (q q':ℚ): q > q' ↔ (q:Real) > (q':Real)
proof: := Real.lt_of_coe _ _

name: Real.mul_lt_mul_right
statement: theorem Real.mul_lt_mul_right {x y z:Real} (hxy: x < y) (hz: z.IsPos) : x * z < y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [antisymm, gt_iff] at hxy ⊢; convert pos_mul hxy hz using 1; ring

name: Real.inv_of_pos
statement: theorem Real.inv_of_pos {x:Real} (hx: x.IsPos) : x⁻¹.IsPos
proof:
:= by
  observe hnon: x ≠ 0
  observe hident : x⁻¹ * x = 1
  have hinv_non: x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hident; simp [hident]
  have hnonneg : ¬x⁻¹.IsNeg := by
    intro h
    observe : (x * x⁻¹).IsNeg
    have id : -(1:Real) = (-1:ℚ) := by simp
    simp only [neg_iff_pos_of_neg, id, pos_of_coe, self_mul_inv hnon] at this
    linarith
  have trich := trichotomous x⁻¹
  simpa [hinv_non, hnonneg] using trich

name: Real.inv_of_gt
statement: theorem Real.inv_of_gt {x y:Real} (hx: x.IsPos) (hy: y.IsPos) (hxy: x > y) : x⁻¹ < y⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  observe hxnon: x ≠ 0
  observe hynon: y ≠ 0
  observe hxinv : x⁻¹.IsPos
  by_contra! this
  have : (1:Real) > 1 := calc
    1 = x * x⁻¹ := (self_mul_inv hxnon).symm
    _ > y * x⁻¹ := mul_lt_mul_right hxy hxinv
    _ ≥ y * y⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_left this hy
    _ = _ := self_mul_inv hynon
  simp at this

name: Real.LIM_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem Real.LIM_of_nonneg {a: ℕ → ℚ} (ha: ∀ n, a n ≥ 0) (hcauchy: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    LIM a ≥ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra! hlim
  set x := LIM a
  rw [←isNeg_iff, isNeg_def] at hlim; choose b hb hb_cauchy hlim using hlim
  rw [boundedAwayNeg_def] at hb; choose c cpos hb using hb
  have claim1 : ∀ n, ¬ (c/2).Close (a n) (b n) := by
    intro n; specialize ha n; specialize hb n
    simp [Section_4_3.close_iff]
    calc
      _ < c := by linarith
      _ ≤ a n - b n := by linarith
      _ ≤ _ := le_abs_self _
  have claim2 : ¬(c/2).EventuallyClose (a:Sequence) (b:Sequence) := by
    contrapose! claim1; rw [Rat.eventuallyClose_iff] at claim1; peel claim1 with N claim1; grind [Section_4_3.close_iff]
  have claim3 : ¬Sequence.Equiv a b := by contrapose! claim2; rw [Sequence.equiv_def] at claim2; solve_by_elim [half_pos]
  simp_rw [x, LIM_eq_LIM hcauchy hb_cauchy] at hlim
  contradiction

name: Real.LIM_mono
statement:
theorem Real.LIM_mono {a b:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy)
  (hmono: ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) :
    LIM a ≤ LIM b
proof:
:= by
  
  have := LIM_of_nonneg (a := b - a) (by intro n; simp [hmono n]) (Sequence.IsCauchy.sub hb ha)
  rw [←Real.LIM_sub hb ha] at this; linarith

name: Real.exists_rat_le_and_nat_gt
statement:
theorem Real.exists_rat_le_and_nat_gt {x:Real} (hx: x.IsPos) :
    (∃ q:ℚ, q > 0 ∧ (q:Real) ≤ x) ∧ ∃ N:ℕ, x < (N:Real)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [isPos_def] at hx; choose a hbound hcauchy heq using hx
  rw [boundedAwayPos_def] at hbound; choose q hq hbound using hbound
  have := Sequence.isBounded_of_isCauchy hcauchy
  rw [Sequence.isBounded_def] at this; choose r hr this using this
  simp [Sequence.boundedBy_def] at this
  refine ⟨ ⟨ q, hq, ?_ ⟩, ?_ ⟩
  . convert LIM_mono (Sequence.IsCauchy.const _) hcauchy hbound
    exact Real.ratCast_def q
  choose N hN using exists_nat_gt r; use N
  calc
    x ≤ r := by
      rw [Real.ratCast_def r]
      convert LIM_mono hcauchy (Sequence.IsCauchy.const r) _
      intro n; specialize this n; simp at this
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans this
    _ < ((N:ℚ):Real) := by simp [hN]
    _ = N := rfl

name: Real.le_mul
statement: theorem Real.le_mul {ε:Real} (hε: ε.IsPos) (x:Real) : ∃ M:ℕ, M > 0 ∧ M * ε > x
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hx | hx := trichotomous x
  . use 1; simpa [isPos_iff] using hε
  . choose N hN using (exists_rat_le_and_nat_gt (div_of_pos hx hε)).2
    set M := N+1; refine ⟨ M, by positivity, ?_ ⟩
    replace hN : x/ε < M := hN.trans (by simp [M])
    simp
    convert mul_lt_mul_right hN hε
    rw [isPos_iff] at hε; field_simp
  use 1; simp_all [isPos_iff]; linarith

name: Real.max_eq
statement: theorem Real.max_eq (x y:Real) : max x y = if x ≥ y then x else y
proof: := max_def' x y

name: Real.min_eq
statement: theorem Real.min_eq (x y:Real) : min x y = if x ≤ y then x else y
proof: := rfl

name: ContinuousWithinAt.iff
statement:
theorem ContinuousWithinAt.iff (X:Set ℝ) (f: ℝ → ℝ)  (x₀:ℝ) :
  ContinuousWithinAt f X x₀ ↔ Convergesto X f (f x₀) x₀
proof:
:= by

name: _root_.Filter.Tendsto.comp_of_continuous
statement:
theorem _root_.Filter.Tendsto.comp_of_continuous {X:Set ℝ} {f: ℝ → ℝ} {x₀:ℝ}
  (h_cont: ContinuousWithinAt f X x₀) {a: ℕ → ℝ} (ha: ∀ n, a n ∈ X)
  (hconv: Filter.atTop.Tendsto a (nhds x₀)):
  Filter.atTop.Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (a n)) (nhds (f x₀))
proof:
:= by
  have := (ContinuousWithinAt.tfae X f x₀).out 0 1
  grind

name: ContinuousWithinAt.add
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff] at hf hg ⊢; convert hf.add hg using 1

name: ContinuousWithinAt.sub
proof:

name: ContinuousWithinAt.div'
statement:
theorem ContinuousWithinAt.div' {X:Set ℝ} (f g: ℝ → ℝ) {x₀:ℝ} (hM: g x₀ ≠ 0)
  (hf: ContinuousWithinAt f X x₀) (hg: ContinuousWithinAt g X x₀) :
  ContinuousWithinAt (f / g) X x₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff] at hf hg ⊢; convert hf.div hM hg using 1

name: _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse
statement:
theorem _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse {X Y: Set ℝ} {f: ℝ → ℝ} {g:ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfXY: ∀ x ∈ X, f x ∈ Y) (hgf: ∀ x ∈ X, g (f x) = x)
  {x₀ y₀ f'x₀ g'y₀: ℝ} (hx₀: x₀ ∈ X) (hfx₀: f x₀ = y₀)
  (hcluster: ClusterPt x₀ (.principal (X \ {x₀})))
  (hf: HasDerivWithinAt f f'x₀ X x₀) (hg: HasDerivWithinAt g g'y₀ Y y₀) :
  g'y₀ * f'x₀ = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : HasDerivWithinAt id (g'y₀ * f'x₀) X x₀ := by
    apply (hf.of_comp hfx₀ hfXY _).congr _ (hgf _ hx₀).symm <;> grind
  observe h2 : HasDerivWithinAt id 1 X x₀
  solve_by_elim [derivative_unique]

name: _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse'
statement:
theorem _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse' {X Y: Set ℝ} {f: ℝ → ℝ} {g:ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfXY: ∀ x ∈ X, f x ∈ Y) (hgf: ∀ x ∈ X, g (f x) = x)
  {x₀ y₀ f'x₀ g'y₀: ℝ} (hx₀: x₀ ∈ X) (hfx₀: f x₀ = y₀)
  (hcluster: ClusterPt x₀ (.principal (X \ {x₀})))
  (hf: HasDerivWithinAt f f'x₀ X x₀) (hg: HasDerivWithinAt g g'y₀ Y y₀) :
  g'y₀ = 1/f'x₀
proof:
:=
    eq_one_div_of_mul_eq_one_left (hf.of_inverse hfXY hgf hx₀ hfx₀ hcluster hg)

name: _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse_of_zero_deriv
statement:
theorem _root_.HasDerivWithinAt.of_inverse_of_zero_deriv {X Y: Set ℝ} {f: ℝ → ℝ} {g:ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfXY: ∀ x ∈ X, f x ∈ Y) (hgf: ∀ x ∈ X, g (f x) = x)
  {x₀ y₀: ℝ} (hx₀: x₀ ∈ X) (hfx₀: f x₀ = y₀)
  (hcluster: ClusterPt x₀ (.principal (X \ {x₀})))
  (hf: HasDerivWithinAt f 0 X x₀) :
  ¬ DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ g Y y₀
proof:
:= by
  by_contra this; rw [DifferentiableWithinAt.iff] at this; choose _ hg using this
  apply hf.of_inverse at hg <;> grind

name: Convergesto.iff
statement:
theorem Convergesto.iff (X:Set ℝ) (f: ℝ → ℝ) (L:ℝ) (x₀:ℝ) :
  Convergesto X f L x₀ ↔ (nhdsWithin x₀ X).Tendsto f (nhds L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Convergesto Real.CloseNear Real.CloseFn nhdsWithin
  rw [LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.tendsto_nhds]
  peel with ε hε
  rw [Filter.eventually_inf_principal]
  simp [Filter.Eventually, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset]
  constructor
  . intro ⟨ δ, _, _ ⟩; use x₀-δ, x₀+δ, by grind
    intro _; simp; grind
  intro ⟨ l, u, ⟨ _, _ ⟩, h ⟩
  have h1 : 0 < x₀ - l := by linarith
  have h2 : 0 < u - x₀ := by linarith
  set δ := min (x₀ - l) (u - x₀)
  observe hδ1 : δ ≤ x₀ - l
  observe hδ2 : δ ≤ u - x₀
  use δ, (by positivity); intro x hxX _ _
  specialize h (show x ∈ .Ioo l u by simp; grind)
  simpa [hxX] using h

name: Convergesto.comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_conv f L] at hf; solve_by_elim

name: Convergesto.uniq
statement:
theorem Convergesto.uniq {E:Set ℝ} {f: ℝ → ℝ} {L L':ℝ} {x₀:ℝ} (h: AdherentPt x₀ E)
  (hf: Convergesto E f L x₀) (hf': Convergesto E f L' x₀) : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  
  let ⟨ a, ha, hconv ⟩ := (limit_of_AdherentPt _ _).mp h
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hf.comp ha hconv) (hf'.comp ha hconv)

name: Convergesto.add
proof:
:= by
    
    rw [iff_conv _ _] at hf hg ⊢
    intro a ha hconv; specialize hf a ha hconv; specialize hg a ha hconv
    convert hf.add hg using 1

name: Real.sign_def
statement: theorem Real.sign_def (x:ℝ) : Real.sign x = if x < 0 then -1 else if x > 0 then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: CauchySequence.ext'
statement: theorem CauchySequence.ext' {a b: CauchySequence} (h: a.seq = b.seq) : a = b
proof:

name: CauchySequence.coe_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CauchySequence.coe_eq {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    (mk' ha).toSequence = (a:Sequence)
proof: := rfl

name: CauchySequence.coe_to_sequence
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CauchySequence.coe_to_sequence (a: CauchySequence) :
    ((a:ℕ → ℚ):Sequence) = a.toSequence
proof:
:= by
  apply Sequence.ext (by simp [Sequence.n0_coe, a.zero])
  ext n; by_cases h:n ≥ 0 <;> simp_all
  rw [a.vanish]; rwa [a.zero]

name: CauchySequence.coe_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CauchySequence.coe_coe {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) : mk' ha = a
proof: := by rfl

name: CauchySequence.equiv_iff
statement: theorem CauchySequence.equiv_iff (a b: CauchySequence) : a ≈ b ↔ Sequence.Equiv a b
proof: := by rfl

name: LIM_def
statement:
theorem LIM_def {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    LIM a = Quotient.mk _ (CauchySequence.mk' ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LIM, dif_pos ha]

name: Real.eq_lim
statement: theorem Real.eq_lim (x:Real) : ∃ (a:ℕ → ℚ), (a:Sequence).IsCauchy ∧ x = LIM a
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.ind _ x; intro a; use (a:ℕ → ℚ)
  observe : ((a:ℕ → ℚ):Sequence) = a.toSequence
  rw [this, LIM_def (by convert a.cauchy)]
  refine ⟨ a.cauchy, ?_ ⟩
  congr; ext n; simp; replace := congr($this n); simp_all

name: Real.LIM_eq_LIM
statement:
theorem Real.LIM_eq_LIM {a b:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
  LIM a = LIM b ↔ Sequence.Equiv a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro h; replace h := Quotient.exact h
    rwa [dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb, CauchySequence.equiv_iff] at h
  intro h; apply Quotient.sound
  rwa [dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb, CauchySequence.equiv_iff]

name: Sequence.IsCauchy.add
statement:
theorem Sequence.IsCauchy.add {a b:ℕ → ℚ}  (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    (a + b:Sequence).IsCauchy
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [coe] at *
  intro ε hε
  choose N1 ha using ha _ (half_pos hε)
  choose N2 hb using hb _ (half_pos hε)
  use max N1 N2
  intro j hj k hk
  have h1 := ha j ?_ k ?_ <;> try omega
  have h2 := hb j ?_ k ?_ <;> try omega
  simp [Section_4_3.dist] at *; rw [←Rat.Close] at *
  convert Section_4_3.add_close h1 h2
  linarith

name: Sequence.add_equiv_left
statement:
theorem Sequence.add_equiv_left {a a':ℕ → ℚ} (b:ℕ → ℚ) (haa': Equiv a a') :
    Equiv (a + b) (a' + b)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [equiv_def] at *
  peel 2 haa' with ε hε haa'
  rw [Rat.eventuallyClose_def] at *
  choose N haa' using haa'; use N
  simp [Rat.closeSeq_def] at *
  peel 5 haa' with n hn hN _ _ haa'
  simp [hn, hN] at *
  convert Section_4_3.add_close haa' (Section_4_3.close_refl (b n.toNat))
  simp

name: Sequence.add_equiv_right
statement:
theorem Sequence.add_equiv_right {b b':ℕ → ℚ} (a:ℕ → ℚ) (hbb': Equiv b b') :
    Equiv (a + b) (a + b')
proof: := by simp_rw [add_comm]; exact add_equiv_left _ hbb'

name: Sequence.add_equiv
statement:
theorem Sequence.add_equiv {a b a' b':ℕ → ℚ} (haa': Equiv a a')
  (hbb': Equiv b b') :
    Equiv (a + b) (a' + b')
proof:
:=
  equiv_trans (add_equiv_left _ haa') (add_equiv_right _ hbb')

name: Real.LIM_add
statement:
theorem Real.LIM_add {a b:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
  LIM a + LIM b = LIM (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [LIM_def ha, LIM_def hb, LIM_def (Sequence.IsCauchy.add ha hb)]
  convert Quotient.liftOn₂_mk _ _ _ _ using 1
  simp [LIM]; grind

name: Sequence.mul_equiv_right
statement:
theorem Sequence.mul_equiv_right {b b':ℕ → ℚ} (a:ℕ → ℚ)  (ha : (a:Sequence).IsCauchy)  (hbb': Equiv b b') :
  Equiv (a * b) (a * b')
proof: := by simp_rw [mul_comm]; exact mul_equiv_left a ha hbb'

name: Sequence.mul_equiv
statement:
theorem Sequence.mul_equiv
  {a b a' b':ℕ → ℚ}
  (ha : (a:Sequence).IsCauchy)
  (hb' : (b':Sequence).IsCauchy)
  (haa': Equiv a a')
  (hbb': Equiv b b') : Equiv (a * b) (a' * b')
proof:
:=
    equiv_trans (mul_equiv_right _ ha hbb') (mul_equiv_left _ hb' haa')

name: Real.LIM_mul
statement:
theorem Real.LIM_mul {a b:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
  LIM a * LIM b = LIM (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [LIM_def ha, LIM_def hb, LIM_def (Sequence.IsCauchy.mul ha hb)]
  convert Quotient.liftOn₂_mk _ _ _ _ using 1
  simp [LIM]; grind

name: Real.ratCast_def
statement: theorem Real.ratCast_def (q:ℚ) : (q:Real) = LIM (fun _ ↦ q)
proof: := by rw [LIM_def]; rfl

name: Real.LIM.zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.LIM.zero : LIM (fun _ ↦ (0:ℚ)) = 0
proof: := by rw [←ratCast_def 0]; rfl

name: Real.sub_eq_add_neg
statement: theorem Real.sub_eq_add_neg (x y:Real) : x - y = x + (-y)
proof: := rfl

name: bounded_away_zero_def
statement:
theorem bounded_away_zero_def (a:ℕ → ℚ) : BoundedAwayZero a ↔
  ∃ (c:ℚ), c > 0 ∧ ∀ n, |a n| ≥ c
proof: := by rfl

name: Real.nonzero_of_boundedAwayZero
statement: theorem Real.nonzero_of_boundedAwayZero {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: BoundedAwayZero a) (n: ℕ) : a n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
   choose c hc ha using ha; specialize ha n; contrapose! ha; simp [ha, hc]

name: Real.inv_isCauchy_of_boundedAwayZero
statement:
theorem Real.inv_isCauchy_of_boundedAwayZero {a:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: BoundedAwayZero a)
  (ha_cauchy: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    ((a⁻¹:ℕ → ℚ):Sequence).IsCauchy
proof:
:= by
  
  have ha' (n:ℕ) : a n ≠ 0 := nonzero_of_boundedAwayZero ha n
  rw [bounded_away_zero_def] at ha; choose c hc ha using ha
  simp_rw [Sequence.IsCauchy.coe, Section_4_3.dist_eq] at ha_cauchy ⊢
  intro ε hε; specialize ha_cauchy (c^2 * ε) (by positivity)
  choose N ha_cauchy using ha_cauchy; use N;
  peel 4 ha_cauchy with n hn m hm ha_cauchy
  calc
    _ = |(a m - a n) / (a m * a n)| := by
        congr; simp only [Pi.inv_apply]; field_simp [ha' m, ha' n]
    _ ≤ |a m - a n| / c^2 := by rw [abs_div, abs_mul, sq]; gcongr <;> solve_by_elim
    _ = |a n - a m| / c^2 := by rw [abs_sub_comm]
    _ ≤ (c^2 * ε) / c^2 := by gcongr
    _ = ε := by field_simp [hc]

name: Real.inv_of_equiv
statement:
theorem Real.inv_of_equiv {a b:ℕ → ℚ} (ha: BoundedAwayZero a)
  (ha_cauchy: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hb: BoundedAwayZero b)
  (hb_cauchy: (b:Sequence).IsCauchy) (hlim: LIM a = LIM b) :
    LIM a⁻¹ = LIM b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  
  set P := LIM a⁻¹ * LIM a * LIM b⁻¹
  have hainv_cauchy := Real.inv_isCauchy_of_boundedAwayZero ha ha_cauchy
  have hbinv_cauchy := Real.inv_isCauchy_of_boundedAwayZero hb hb_cauchy
  have haainv_cauchy := hainv_cauchy.mul ha_cauchy
  have habinv_cauchy := hainv_cauchy.mul hb_cauchy
  have claim1 : P = LIM b⁻¹ := by
    simp only [P, LIM_mul hainv_cauchy ha_cauchy, LIM_mul haainv_cauchy hbinv_cauchy]
    rcongr n; simp [nonzero_of_boundedAwayZero ha n]
  have claim2 : P = LIM a⁻¹ := by
    simp only [P, hlim, LIM_mul hainv_cauchy hb_cauchy, LIM_mul habinv_cauchy hbinv_cauchy]
    rcongr n; simp [nonzero_of_boundedAwayZero hb n]
  grind

name: Real.inv_def
statement:
theorem Real.inv_def {a:ℕ → ℚ} (h: BoundedAwayZero a) (hc: (a:Sequence).IsCauchy) :
    (LIM a)⁻¹ = LIM a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  observe hx : LIM a ≠ 0
  set x := LIM a
  have ⟨ h1, h2, h3 ⟩ := (boundedAwayZero_of_nonzero hx).choose_spec
  simp [Inv.inv, hx]
  exact inv_of_equiv h2 h1 h hc h3.symm

name: Real.inv_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.inv_zero : (0:Real)⁻¹ = 0
proof: := by simp [Inv.inv]

name: BoundedAwayZero.const
statement: lemma BoundedAwayZero.const {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : BoundedAwayZero fun _ ↦ q
proof:
:= by
  use |q|; simp [hq]

name: Real.inv_ratCast
statement: theorem Real.inv_ratCast (q:ℚ) : (q:Real)⁻¹ = (q⁻¹:ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q = 0
  . rw [h, ← show (0:Real) = (0:ℚ) by norm_cast]; norm_num; norm_cast
  simp_rw [ratCast_def, inv_def (BoundedAwayZero.const h) (by apply Sequence.IsCauchy.const)]; congr

name: Real.div_eq
statement: theorem Real.div_eq (x y:Real) : x/y = x * y⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: Sequence.IsCauchy.harmonic'
statement: theorem Sequence.IsCauchy.harmonic' : ((fun n ↦ 1/((n:ℚ)+1): ℕ → ℚ):Sequence).IsCauchy
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe]; intro ε hε; choose N h1 h2 using (mk _).mp harmonic ε hε
  use N.toNat; intro j _ k _; specialize h2 (j+1) _ (k+1) _ <;> try omega
  simp_all

name: Sequence.convergent_of_subseq_of_bounded
statement:
theorem Sequence.convergent_of_subseq_of_bounded {a:ℕ→ ℝ} (ha: (a:Sequence).IsBounded) :
    ∃ b:ℕ → ℝ, Sequence.subseq a b ∧ (b:Sequence).Convergent
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨ ⟨ L_plus, hL_plus ⟩, ⟨ _, _ ⟩ ⟩ := finite_limsup_liminf_of_bounded ha
  have := limit_point_of_limsup hL_plus
  rw [limit_point_iff_subseq] at this; peel 2 this; solve_by_elim

name: Nat.zero_succ
statement: lemma Nat.zero_succ : 0++ = 1
proof: := by rfl

name: Nat.one_succ
statement: lemma Nat.one_succ : 1++ = 2
proof: := by rfl

name: Nat.two_succ
statement: lemma Nat.two_succ : 2++ = 3
proof: := by rfl

name: Nat.succ_ne
statement: theorem Nat.succ_ne (n:Nat) : n++ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  injection h

name: Nat.four_ne
statement: theorem Nat.four_ne : (4:Nat) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  change 3++ ≠ 0
  
  exact succ_ne _

name: Nat.succ_cancel
statement: theorem Nat.succ_cancel {n m:Nat} (hnm: n++ = m++) : n = m
proof:
:= by
  injection hnm

name: Nat.succ_ne_succ
statement: theorem Nat.succ_ne_succ (n m:Nat) : n ≠ m → n++ ≠ m++
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  contrapose! h
  exact succ_cancel h

name: Nat.six_ne_two
statement: theorem Nat.six_ne_two : (6:Nat) ≠ 2
proof:
:= by

  by_contra h
  change 5++ = 1++ at h
  apply succ_cancel at h
  change 4++ = 0++ at h
  apply succ_cancel at h
  have := four_ne
  contradiction

name: Nat.six_ne_two'
statement: theorem Nat.six_ne_two' : (6:Nat) ≠ 2
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Nat.induction
statement:
theorem Nat.induction (P : Nat → Prop) (hbase : P 0) (hind : ∀ n, P n → P (n++)) :
    ∀ n, P n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hbase
  | succ n ih => exact hind _ ih

name: Nat.recurse_zero
statement: theorem Nat.recurse_zero (f: Nat → Nat → Nat) (c: Nat) : Nat.recurse f c 0 = c
proof: := by rfl

name: Nat.recurse_succ
statement:
theorem Nat.recurse_succ (f: Nat → Nat → Nat) (c: Nat) (n: Nat) :
    recurse f c (n++) = f n (recurse f c n)
proof: := by rfl

name: Nat.eq_recurse
statement:
theorem Nat.eq_recurse (f: Nat → Nat → Nat) (c: Nat) (a: Nat → Nat) :
    (a 0 = c ∧ ∀ n, a (n++) = f n (a n)) ↔ a = recurse f c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro ⟨ h0, hsucc ⟩
    
    apply funext; apply induction
    . exact h0
    intro n hn
    rw [hsucc n, recurse_succ, hn]
  intro h
  rw [h]
  constructor 
  . exact recurse_zero _ _
  exact recurse_succ _ _

name: Nat.recurse_uniq
statement:
theorem Nat.recurse_uniq (f: Nat → Nat → Nat) (c: Nat) :
    ∃! (a: Nat → Nat), a 0 = c ∧ ∀ n, a (n++) = f n (a n)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExistsUnique.intro (recurse f c)
  . constructor 
    . exact recurse_zero _ _
    . exact recurse_succ _ _
  intro a
  exact (eq_recurse _ _ a).mp

name: Series.eval_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Series.eval_coe (a: ℕ → ℝ) (n: ℕ) : (a: Series).seq n = a n
proof: := by simp

name: Series.eval_mk'
statement:
theorem Series.eval_mk' {m:ℤ} (a : { n // n ≥ m } → ℝ) {n : ℤ} (h:n ≥ m) :
    (Series.mk' a).seq n = a ⟨ n, h ⟩
proof: := by simp [h]

name: Series.partial_succ
statement: theorem Series.partial_succ (s : Series) {N:ℤ} (h: N ≥ s.m-1) : s.partial (N+1) = s.partial N + s.seq (N+1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Series.partial
  rw [add_comm (s.partial N) _]
  convert Finset.sum_insert (show N+1 ∉ Finset.Icc s.m N by simp)
  symm; apply Finset.insert_Icc_right_eq_Icc_add_one; linarith

name: Series.partial_of_lt
statement: theorem Series.partial_of_lt {s : Series} {N:ℤ} (h: N < s.m) : s.partial N = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Series.partial
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  intro n hn; simp at hn; grind

name: Series.converges_of_convergesTo
statement:
theorem Series.converges_of_convergesTo {s : Series} {L:ℝ} (h: s.convergesTo L) :
    s.converges
proof: := by use L

name: Series.sum_of_converges
statement: theorem Series.sum_of_converges {s : Series} {L:ℝ} (h: s.convergesTo L) : s.sum = L
proof:
:= by
  simp [sum, converges_of_convergesTo h]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique ((converges_of_convergesTo h).choose_spec) h

name: Series.convergesTo_uniq
statement:
theorem Series.convergesTo_uniq {s : Series} {L L':ℝ} (h: s.convergesTo L) (h': s.convergesTo L') :
    L = L'
proof: := tendsto_nhds_unique h h'

name: Series.convergesTo_sum
statement: theorem Series.convergesTo_sum {s : Series} (h: s.converges) : s.convergesTo s.sum
proof:
:= by
  simp [sum, h]; exact h.choose_spec

name: Series.add_coe
statement: theorem Series.add_coe (a b: ℕ → ℝ) : (a:Series) + (b:Series) = (fun n ↦ a n + b n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rfl
  change (a:Series).seq n + (b:Series).seq n = _
  by_cases h:n ≥ 0 <;> simp [h]

name: Series.smul_coe
statement: theorem Series.smul_coe (a: ℕ → ℝ) (c: ℝ) : (c • a:Series) = (fun n ↦ c * a n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rfl
  by_cases h:n ≥ 0 <;> simp [h, HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul]

name: Series.sub_coe
statement: theorem Series.sub_coe (a b: ℕ → ℝ) : (a:Series) - (b:Series) = (fun n ↦ a n - b n)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rfl
  change (a:Series).seq n - (b:Series).seq n = _
  by_cases h:n ≥ 0 <;> simp [h]

name: OrderedPair.eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem OrderedPair.eq (x y x' y' : Object) :
    (⟨ x, y ⟩ : OrderedPair) = (⟨ x', y' ⟩ : OrderedPair) ↔ x = x' ∧ y = y'
proof: := by aesop

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_slice
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_slice (x z:Object) (Y:Set) :
    z ∈ (SetTheory.Set.slice x Y) ↔ ∃ y:Y, z = (⟨x, y⟩:OrderedPair)
proof: := replacement_axiom _ _

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_cartesian
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_cartesian (z:Object) (X Y:Set) :
    z ∈ X ×ˢ Y ↔ ∃ x:X, ∃ y:Y, z = (⟨x, y⟩:OrderedPair)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SProd.sprod, union_axiom]; constructor
  . intro ⟨ S, hz, hS ⟩; rw [replacement_axiom] at hS; obtain ⟨ x, hx ⟩ := hS
    use x; simp_all
  rintro ⟨ x, y, rfl ⟩; use slice x Y; refine ⟨ by simp, ?_ ⟩
  rw [replacement_axiom]; use x

name: SetTheory.Set.pair_eq_fst_snd
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.pair_eq_fst_snd {X Y:Set} (z:X ×ˢ Y) :
    z.val = (⟨ fst z, snd z ⟩:OrderedPair)
proof:
:= by
  have := (mem_cartesian _ _ _).mp z.property
  obtain ⟨ y, hy: z.val = (⟨ fst z, y ⟩:OrderedPair)⟩ := this.choose_spec
  obtain ⟨ x, hx: z.val = (⟨ x, snd z ⟩:OrderedPair)⟩ := (exists_comm.mp this).choose_spec
  simp_all [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: SetTheory.Set.fst_of_mk_cartesian
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.fst_of_mk_cartesian {X Y:Set} (x:X) (y:Y) :
    fst (mk_cartesian x y) = x
proof:
:= by
  let z := mk_cartesian x y; have := (mem_cartesian _ _ _).mp z.property
  obtain ⟨ y', hy: z.val = (⟨ fst z, y' ⟩:OrderedPair) ⟩ := this.choose_spec
  simp [z, mk_cartesian, Subtype.val_inj] at *; rw [←hy.1]

name: SetTheory.Set.snd_of_mk_cartesian
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.snd_of_mk_cartesian {X Y:Set} (x:X) (y:Y) :
    snd (mk_cartesian x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  let z := mk_cartesian x y; have := (mem_cartesian _ _ _).mp z.property
  obtain ⟨ x', hx: z.val = (⟨ x', snd z ⟩:OrderedPair) ⟩ := (exists_comm.mp this).choose_spec
  simp [z, mk_cartesian, Subtype.val_inj] at *; rw [←hx.2]

name: SetTheory.Set.mk_cartesian_fst_snd_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.mk_cartesian_fst_snd_eq {X Y: Set} (z: X ×ˢ Y) :
    (mk_cartesian (fst z) (snd z)) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_cartesian, Subtype.mk.injEq, pair_eq_fst_snd]

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_iProd
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_iProd {I: Set} {X: I → Set} (t:Object) :
    t ∈ iProd X ↔ ∃ x: ∀ i, X i, t = tuple x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [iProd, specification_axiom'']; constructor
  . intro ⟨ ht, x, h ⟩; use x
  intro ⟨ x, hx ⟩
  have h : t ∈ (I.iUnion X)^I := by simp [hx]
  use h, x

name: SetTheory.Set.tuple_mem_iProd
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.tuple_mem_iProd {I: Set} {X: I → Set} (x: ∀ i, X i) :
    tuple x ∈ iProd X
proof: := by rw [mem_iProd]; use x

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_Fin
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_Fin (n:ℕ) (x:Object) : x ∈ Fin n ↔ ∃ m, m < n ∧ x = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [specification_axiom'']; constructor
  . intro ⟨ h1, h2 ⟩; use ↑(⟨ x, h1 ⟩:nat); simp [h2]
  intro ⟨ m, hm, h ⟩
  use (by rw [h, ←Object.ofnat_eq]; exact (m:nat).property)
  grind [Object.ofnat_eq''']

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_Fin'
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_Fin' {n:ℕ} (x:Fin n) : ∃ m, ∃ h : m < n, x = Fin_mk n m h
proof:
:= by
  choose m hm this using (mem_Fin _ _).mp x.property; use m, hm
  simp [Fin_mk, ←Subtype.val_inj, this]

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_spec
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_spec {n:ℕ} (i: Fin n) :
    ∃ h : i < n, i = Fin_mk n i h
proof: := (mem_Fin' i).choose_spec

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_lt
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_lt {n:ℕ} (i: Fin n) : i < n
proof: := (toNat_spec i).choose

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_toNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_toNat {n:ℕ} (i: Fin n) : ((i:ℕ):Object) = (i:Object)
proof:
:= by
  set j := (i:ℕ); obtain ⟨ h, h':i = Fin_mk n j h ⟩ := toNat_spec i; rw [h']

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_inj
statement:
@[simp low]
lemma SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_inj {n:ℕ} {i j: Fin n} : i = j ↔ (i:ℕ) = (j:ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp_all
  obtain ⟨_, hi⟩ := toNat_spec i
  obtain ⟨_, hj⟩ := toNat_spec j
  grind

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_eq_iff {n:ℕ} (i: Fin n) {j:ℕ} : (i:Object) = (j:Object) ↔ i = j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Subtype.coe_eq_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := h
    simp [←Object.natCast_inj]
  aesop

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_eq_iff'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.coe_eq_iff' {n m:ℕ} (i: Fin n) (hi : ↑i ∈ Fin m) : ((⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin m):ℕ) = (i:ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨val, property⟩ := i
  simp only [toNat, Subtype.mk.injEq, exists_prop]
  generalize_proofs h1 h2
  suffices : (h1.choose: Object) = h2.choose
  · aesop
  have := h1.choose_spec
  have := h2.choose_spec
  grind

name: SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.Fin.toNat_mk {n:ℕ} (m:ℕ) (h: m < n) : (Fin_mk n m h : ℕ) = m
proof:
:= by
  have := coe_toNat (Fin_mk n m h)
  rwa [Object.natCast_inj] at this

name: SetTheory.Set.finite_choice
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.finite_choice {n:ℕ} {X: Fin n → Set} (h: ∀ i, X i ≠ ∅) : iProd X ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  
  induction' n with n hn
  . have : Fin 0 = ∅ := by
      rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      grind [specification_axiom'']
    have empty (i:Fin 0) : X i := False.elim (by rw [this] at i; exact not_mem_empty i i.property)
    apply nonempty_of_inhabited (x := tuple empty); rw [mem_iProd]; use empty
  set X' : Fin n → Set := fun i ↦ X (Fin_embed n (n+1) (by linarith) i)
  have hX' (i: Fin n) : X' i ≠ ∅ := h _
  choose x'_obj hx' using nonempty_def (hn hX')
  rw [mem_iProd] at hx'; obtain ⟨ x', rfl ⟩ := hx'
  set last : Fin (n+1) := Fin_mk (n+1) n (by linarith)
  choose a ha using nonempty_def (h last)
  have x : ∀ i, X i := fun i =>
    if h : i = n then
      have : i = last := by ext; simpa [←Fin.coe_toNat, last]
      ⟨a, by grind⟩
    else
      have : i < n := lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Fin.toNat_lt i)) h
      let i' := Fin_mk n i this
      have : X i = X' i' := by simp [X', i', Fin_embed]
      ⟨x' i', by grind⟩
  exact nonempty_of_inhabited (tuple_mem_iProd x)

name: SetTheory.Set.Tuple.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma SetTheory.Set.Tuple.ext {n:ℕ} {t t':Tuple n}
    (hX : t.X = t'.X)
    (hx : ∀ n : Fin n, ((t.x n):Object) = ((t'.x n):Object)) :
    t = t'
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨_, _, _⟩ := t; have ⟨_, _, _⟩ := t'; subst hX; congr; ext; grind

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_image
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_image {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (S: Set) (y:Object) :
    y ∈ image f S ↔ ∃ x:X, x.val ∈ S ∧ f x = y
proof:
:= by
  grind [replacement_axiom]

name: SetTheory.Set.image_eq_image
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.image_eq_image {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (S: Set):
    (image f S: _root_.Set Object) = Subtype.val '' (f '' {x | x.val ∈ S})
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp; grind

name: SetTheory.Set.image_in_codomain
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.image_in_codomain {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (S: Set) :
    image f S ⊆ Y
proof: := by intro _ h; rw [mem_image] at h; grind

name: SetTheory.Set.image_f_3_4_2
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.image_f_3_4_2 : image f_3_4_2 {1,2,3} = {2,4,6}
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp only [mem_image, mem_triple, f_3_4_2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, (_ | _ | _), rfl⟩ <;> simp_all
  rintro (_ | _ | _); map_tacs [use 1; use 2; use 3]
  all_goals simp_all

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_preimage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_preimage {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (U: Set) (x:X) :
    x.val ∈ preimage f U ↔ (f x).val ∈ U
proof: := by rw [specification_axiom']

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_preimage'
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_preimage' {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (U: Set) (x:Object) :
    x ∈ preimage f U ↔ ∃ x': X, x'.val = x ∧ (f x').val ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro h; by_cases hx: x ∈ X
    . use ⟨ x, hx ⟩; have := mem_preimage f U ⟨ _, hx ⟩; simp_all
    . grind [specification_axiom]
  . rintro ⟨ x', rfl, hfx' ⟩; rwa [mem_preimage]

name: SetTheory.Set.preimage_eq
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.preimage_eq {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (U: Set) :
    ((preimage f U): _root_.Set Object) = Subtype.val '' (f⁻¹' {y | y.val ∈ U})
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: SetTheory.Set.preimage_in_domain
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.preimage_in_domain {X Y:Set} (f:X → Y) (U: Set) :
    (preimage f U) ⊆ X
proof: := by intro _ _; aesop

name: SetTheory.Set.preimage_f_3_4_2
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.preimage_f_3_4_2 : preimage f_3_4_2 {2,4,6} = {1,2,3}
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp only [mem_preimage', mem_triple, f_3_4_2]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl, (_ | _ | _)⟩ <;> simp_all <;> omega
  rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl); map_tacs [use 1; use 2; use 3]
  all_goals simp

name: SetTheory.Set.coe_of_fun_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.coe_of_fun_inj {X Y:Set} (f g:X → Y) : (f:Object) = (g:Object) ↔ f = g
proof:
:= by
  simp [coe_of_fun]

name: SetTheory.Set.powerset_axiom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SetTheory.Set.powerset_axiom {X Y:Set} (F:Object) :
    F ∈ (X ^ Y) ↔ ∃ f: Y → X, f = F
proof: := SetTheory.powerset_axiom X Y F

name: SetTheory.Set.example_3_4_9
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.example_3_4_9 (F:Object) :
    F ∈ ({0,1}:Set) ^ ({4,7}:Set) ↔ F = f_3_4_9_a
    ∨ F = f_3_4_9_b ∨ F = f_3_4_9_c ∨ F = f_3_4_9_d
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerset_axiom]
  refine ⟨?_, by aesop ⟩
  rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
  have h1 := (f ⟨4, by simp⟩).property
  have h2 := (f ⟨7, by simp⟩).property
  simp [coe_of_fun_inj] at *
  obtain _ | _ := h1 <;> obtain _ | _ := h2
  map_tacs [left; (right;left); (right;right;left); (right;right;right)]
  all_goals ext ⟨_, hx⟩; simp at hx; grind

name: SetTheory.Set.exists_powerset
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.exists_powerset (X:Set) :
   ∃ (Z: Set), ∀ x, x ∈ Z ↔ ∃ Y:Set, x = Y ∧ Y ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  use powerset X; apply mem_powerset

name: SetTheory.Set.powerset_of_triple
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.powerset_of_triple (a b c x:Object) :
    x ∈ powerset {a,b,c}
    ↔ x = (∅:Set)
    ∨ x = ({a}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({b}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({c}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({a,b}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({a,c}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({b,c}:Set)
    ∨ x = ({a,b,c}:Set)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_powerset, subset_def, mem_triple]
  refine ⟨ ?_, by aesop ⟩
  rintro ⟨Y, rfl, hY⟩; by_cases a ∈ Y <;> by_cases b ∈ Y <;> by_cases c ∈ Y
  on_goal 8 => left
  on_goal 4 => right; left
  on_goal 6 => right; right; left
  on_goal 7 => right; right; right; left
  on_goal 2 => right; right; right; right; left
  on_goal 3 => right; right; right; right; right; left
  on_goal 5 => right; right; right; right; right; right; left
  on_goal 1 => right; right; right; right; right; right; right
  all_goals congr; ext; simp; grind

name: SetTheory.Set.union_axiom
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.union_axiom (A: Set) (x:Object) :
    x ∈ union A ↔ ∃ (S:Set), x ∈ S ∧ (S:Object) ∈ A
proof: := SetTheory.union_axiom A x

name: SetTheory.Set.union_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [union_axiom, Set.mem_sUnion]; aesop

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_iUnion
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.mem_iUnion {I:Set} (A: I → Set) (x:Object) :
    x ∈ iUnion I A ↔ ∃ α:I, x ∈ A α
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_axiom]; constructor
  . simp_all [replacement_axiom]
  grind [replacement_axiom]

name: SetTheory.Set.iUnion_example
statement: theorem SetTheory.Set.iUnion_example : iUnion {1,2,3} index_example = {2,3,4,5}
proof:
:= by
  apply ext; intros; simp [mem_iUnion, index_example, Insert.insert]
  refine ⟨ by aesop, ?_ ⟩; rintro (_ | _ | _); map_tacs [use 1; use 2; use 3]
  all_goals aesop

name: SetTheory.Set.iUnion_eq
statement:
theorem SetTheory.Set.iUnion_eq (I: Set) (A: I → Set) :
    (iUnion I A : _root_.Set Object) = ⋃ α, (A α: _root_.Set Object)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [mem_iUnion]

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_powerset'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma SetTheory.Set.mem_powerset' {S S' : Set} : (S': Object) ∈ S.powerset ↔ S' ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_powerset]

name: SetTheory.Set.mem_union_powerset_replace_iff
statement:
lemma SetTheory.Set.mem_union_powerset_replace_iff {S : Set} {P : S.powerset → Object → Prop} {hP : _} {x : Object} :
    x ∈ union (S.powerset.replace (P := P) hP) ↔
    ∃ (S' : S.powerset) (U : Set), P S' U ∧ x ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  grind [union_axiom, replacement_axiom]

name: Series.converges_of_nonneg_iff
statement: theorem Series.converges_of_nonneg_iff {s: Series} (h: s.nonneg) : s.converges ↔ ∃ M, ∀ N, s.partial N ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  
  constructor
  . intro hconv
    set S : Chapter6.Sequence := ⟨ s.m, s.partial, by intro n hn; simp [Series.partial, hn] ⟩
    have : S.IsBounded := by
      apply S.bounded_of_convergent
      rw [Chapter6.Sequence.converges_iff_Tendsto']
      grind
    choose M hpos hM using this
    use M; peel hM with N hM
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hM
  intro hbound
  obtain hinfin | hfin := tendsto_atTop_of_monotone (partial_of_nonneg h)
  . choose M hM using hbound
    choose N hN using (hinfin.eventually_gt_atTop M).exists
    grind
  assumption

name: Series.sum_of_nonneg_lt
statement: theorem Series.sum_of_nonneg_lt {s: Series} (h: s.nonneg) {M:ℝ} (hM: ∀ N, s.partial N ≤ M) : s.sum ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ M, ∀ N, s.partial N ≤ M  := by use M
  rw [←converges_of_nonneg_iff h] at this; simp [sum, this]
  have hconv := this.choose_spec; simp [convergesTo] at hconv; exact le_of_tendsto' hconv hM

name: Series.partial_le_sum_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem Series.partial_le_sum_of_nonneg {s: Series} (hnon: s.nonneg) (hconv: s.converges) (N : ℤ) :
  s.partial N ≤ s.sum
proof:
:= by
  apply (partial_of_nonneg hnon).ge_of_tendsto
  simp [sum, hconv]; exact hconv.choose_spec

name: Series.partial_nonneg
statement: theorem Series.partial_nonneg {s: Series} (hnon: s.nonneg) (N : ℤ) : 0 ≤ s.partial N
proof:
:= by
  simp [Series.partial]; apply Finset.sum_nonneg; aesop

name: Series.sum_of_nonneg
statement: theorem Series.sum_of_nonneg {s:Series} (hnon: s.nonneg) : 0 ≤ s.sum
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h: s.converges <;> simp [Series.sum, h]
  exact ge_of_tendsto' h.choose_spec (partial_nonneg hnon)

name: Series.cauchy_criterion
statement: theorem Series.cauchy_criterion {s:Series} (hm: s.m = 1) (hs:s.nonneg) (hmono: ∀ n ≥ 1, s.seq (n+1) ≤ s.seq n) : s.converges ↔ (fun k ↦ 2^k * s.seq (2^k): Series).converges
proof:
:= by
  
  set t := (fun k ↦ 2^k * s.seq (2^k):Series)
  have ht: t.nonneg := by intro n; by_cases h: n ≥ 0 <;> simp [t,h]; grind
  have hmono' : ∀ n ≥ 1, ∀ m ≥ n, s.seq m ≤ s.seq n := by
    intro n hn m hm; obtain ⟨ k, rfl ⟩ := Int.le.dest hm; clear hm
    induction' k with k hk; simp
    convert (hmono (n+k) (by grind)).trans hk using 2; grind
  have htm : t.m = 0 := by simp [t]
  rw [converges_of_nonneg_iff hs, converges_of_nonneg_iff ht]
  set S := s.partial
  set T := t.partial
  have Lemma_7_3_6 (K:ℕ) : S (2^(K+1) - 1) ≤ T K ∧ T K ≤ 2 * S (2^K) := by
    induction' K with K hK
    . simp [S,T,Series.partial, hm, t]; grind
    observe h2K : 1 ≤ 2^K; observe h2K' : 1 ≤ 2^(K+1)
    choose hK1 hK2 using hK
    have claim1 : T (K + 1) = T K + 2^(K+1) * s.seq (2^(K+1)) := by apply t.partial_succ; grind
    have claim2a : S (2^(K+1)) ≥ S (2^K) + 2^K * s.seq (2^(K+1)) := calc
      _ = S (2^K) + ∑ n ∈ .Ioc (2^K) (2^(K+1)), s.seq n := by
        have : Disjoint (Finset.Icc s.m (2^K)) (Finset.Ioc (2^K) (2^(K+1))) := by
          rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]; intro x hx y hy; simp at hx hy; linarith
        convert Finset.sum_union this
        ext x; simp; constructor
        . intro ⟨h1, h2⟩; simp [h1, h2, le_or_gt]
        rintro (⟨ h1, h2 ⟩ | ⟨ h1, h2 ⟩)
        . simp [h1,pow_succ']; linarith
        simp [h2, hm]; grind
      _ ≥ S (2^K) + ∑ n ∈ .Ioc ((2:ℤ)^K) (2^(K+1)), s.seq (2^(K+1)) := by
        gcongr with n hn; simp at hn; exact hmono' _ (by grind) _ hn.2
      _ = _ := by simp [pow_succ']; left; ring_nf; norm_cast
    have claim2 : 2 * S (2^(K+1)) ≥ 2 * S (2^K) + 2^(K+1) * s.seq (2^(K+1)) := by
      nth_rewrite 2 [pow_succ']; grind
    have claim3 : S (2^(K+1+1) - 1) ≤ S (2^(K+1)-1) + 2^(K+1) * s.seq (2^(K+1)) := calc
      _ = S (2^(K+1)-1) + ∑ n ∈ .Icc (2^(K+1)) (2^(K+1+1)-1), s.seq n := by
        have : Disjoint (Finset.Icc s.m (2^(K+1)-1)) (Finset.Icc (2^(K+1)) (2^(K+1+1)-1)) := by
          rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]; intro x hx y hy; simp at hx hy; linarith
        convert Finset.sum_union this
        ext; simp; constructor
        . intro ⟨h1, h2⟩; simp [h1, h2]; omega
        rintro (⟨ h1, h2 ⟩ | ⟨ h1, h2 ⟩)
        . simp [h1, pow_succ' _ (K+1)]; linarith
        simp [h2, hm]; linarith
      _ ≤ S (2^(K+1)-1) + ∑ n ∈ .Icc ((2:ℤ)^(K+1)) (2^(K+1+1)-1), s.seq (2^(K+1)) := by
        gcongr with n hn; simp at hn; apply hmono' _ _ _ hn.1; linarith
      _ = _ := by simp [pow_succ']; left; ring_nf; norm_cast
    simp; constructor <;> grind
  constructor
  . intro ⟨ M, hM ⟩; use 2*M; intro N; obtain hN | hN := lt_or_ge N 0
    . simp [T, Series.partial, htm, hN]; convert hM 0; simp [S, Series.partial, hm]
    rw [Int.eq_natCast_toNat.mpr hN]; apply (Lemma_7_3_6 N.toNat).2.trans; grind
  intro ⟨ M, hM ⟩; use M; intro K'; obtain hK' | hK' := lt_or_ge K' 1
  . simp [S, Series.partial, hm, hK']; convert hM (-1)
  set K := (K'-1).toNat; have hK : K' = K + 1 := by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; abel
  calc
    _ ≤ S (2 ^ (K+1) - 1) := by
      apply partial_of_nonneg hs; rw [hK]
      generalize K = n; induction' n with n hn; simp
      simp [pow_succ] at *; linarith
    _ ≤ T K := (Lemma_7_3_6 K).1
    _ ≤ M := hM K

name: Series.converges_qseries
statement: theorem Series.converges_qseries (q: ℝ) (hq: q > 0) : (mk' (m := 1) fun n ↦ 1 / (n:ℝ) ^ q : Series).converges ↔ (q>1)
proof:
:= by
  
  set s := (mk' (m := 1) fun n ↦ 1 / (n:ℝ) ^ q : Series)
  have hs : s.nonneg := by intro n; simp [s]; by_cases h : 1 ≤ n <;> simp [h]; positivity
  have hmono : ∀ n ≥ 1, s.seq (n+1) ≤ s.seq n := by
    intro n hn
    have hn1 : n ≥ 0 := by positivity
    have hn3 : n.toNat > 0 := by omega
    simp [s, hn, hn1]
    apply_rules [inv_anti₀, rpow_le_rpow] <;> try positivity
    simp
  rw [cauchy_criterion (by simp [s]) hs hmono]
  have (n:ℕ) : 2^n * s.seq (2^n) = (2^(1-q))^n := by
    have : 1 ≤ (2:ℤ)^n := by norm_cast; exact Nat.one_le_two_pow
    simp [s, this]
    rw [←rpow_neg, mul_comm, ←rpow_add_one, rpow_pow_comm] <;> (try positivity); grind
  simp [this, converges_geom_iff]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg, rpow_lt_one_iff_of_pos] <;> try positivity
  simp

name: Series.zeta_eq
statement: theorem Series.zeta_eq {q:ℝ} (hq: q > 1) : (mk' (m := 1) fun n ↦ 1 / (n:ℝ) ^ q : Series).sum = riemannZeta q
proof:
:= by
  
  set L := ∑' n:ℕ, 1 / (n+1:ℝ)^q
  have hL : L = riemannZeta q := by
    rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_add_one_cpow (by norm_cast)]
    convert Complex.ofReal_tsum _ with n
    simp [Complex.ofReal_cpow (x := n+1) (by positivity) _]
  rw [←hL]
  norm_cast; apply sum_of_converges
  have : Summable (fun (n : ℕ)↦ 1 / (n+1:ℝ) ^ q) := by
    convert (summable_one_div_nat_add_rpow 1 q).mpr hq using 4 with n
    rw [abs_of_nonneg]; positivity
  have tail (a: ℤ → ℝ) (L:ℝ) : Filter.atTop.Tendsto a (nhds L) ↔ Filter.atTop.Tendsto (fun n:ℕ ↦ a n) (nhds L) := by
    convert Filter.tendsto_map'_iff (g:= fun n:ℕ ↦ (n:ℤ) )
    simp
  unfold convergesTo
  rw [tail _ L]
  convert Summable.tendsto_sum_tsum_nat this with n
  simp [Series.partial]
  set e : ℕ ↪ ℤ := {
    toFun n := n+1
    inj' _ _ _ := by grind
  }
  convert Finset.sum_map _ e _ using 2 with n _ m hm
  . ext x; simp [e]; constructor
    . intro ⟨ _, _ ⟩; use (x-1).toNat; omega
    grind
  simp [e]

name: Series.Basel_problem
statement: theorem Series.Basel_problem :  (mk' (m := 1) fun n ↦ 1 / (n:ℝ) ^ 2 : Series).sum = Real.pi ^ 2 / 6
proof:
:= by
  have := zeta_eq (show 2 > 1 by norm_num)
  simp [Complex.ofReal_ofNat, riemannZeta_two] at this
  simpa [←Complex.ofReal_inj]

name: NNRealDecimal.surj
statement: theorem NNRealDecimal.surj (x:NNReal) : ∃ d:NNRealDecimal, x = d
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases h : x = 0
  . use mk 0 fun _ ↦ 0; simp [h, toNNReal]
  let s : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ ⌊ x * 10^n ⌋₊
  have hs (n:ℕ) : s n ≤ x * 10^n := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hs' (n:ℕ) : x * 10^n < s n + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hdigit (n:ℕ) : ∃ a:Digit, s (n+1) = 10 * s n + (a:ℕ) := by
    have hl : (10:NNReal) * s n < s (n+1) + 1 := calc
      _ ≤ 10 * (x * 10^n) := by gcongr; grind
      _ = x * 10^(n+1) := by ring_nf
      _ < _ := hs' _
    have hu : s (n+1) < (10:NNReal) * s n + 10 := calc
      _ ≤ x * 10^(n+1) := hs (n+1)
      _ = 10 * (x * 10^n) := by ring_nf
      _ < 10 * (s n + 1) := by gcongr; grind
      _ = _ := by ring
    norm_cast at hl hu
    set d := s (n+1) - 10 * s n
    have hd : d < 10 := by omega
    have : s (n+1) = 10 * s n + d := by omega
    use Digit.mk hd
  choose a ha using hdigit
  set d := mk (s 0) a; use d
  have hsum (n:ℕ) : s n * (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) = s 0 + ∑ i ∈ .range n, a i * (10:NNReal)^(-i-1:ℝ) := by
    induction' n with n hn; simp
    rw [ha n]; calc
      _ = s n * (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) + a n * 10^(-n-1:ℝ) := by
        simp [add_mul]; ring_nf; congr 1
        rw [mul_assoc, ←rpow_add_one]; ring_nf; norm_num
      _ = s 0 + (∑ i ∈ .range n, a i * (10:NNReal)^(-i-1:ℝ) + a n * 10^(-n-1:ℝ)) := by grind
      _ = _ := by congr; symm; apply Finset.sum_range_succ
  have := (d.toNNReal_conv.tendsto_sum_tsum_nat).const_add (s 0:NNReal)
  convert_to Filter.atTop.Tendsto (fun n ↦ s n * (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ)) (nhds (d:NNReal)) at this
  . ext n; rw [hsum n]
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique _ this
  apply Filter.Tendsto.squeeze (g := fun n:ℕ ↦ x - (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ)) (h := fun _ ↦ x)
  . convert Filter.Tendsto.const_sub (c := 0) x _
    . simp
    convert tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (?_:(1/10:NNReal) < 1) with n
    . rw [←rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_rpow, rpow_neg]
    apply div_lt_one_of_lt; bound
  . exact tendsto_const_nhds
  . intro n; simp; calc
    _ = (x * 10^n) * (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ←rpow_natCast, ←rpow_add]; simp; norm_num
    _ ≤ ((s n:NNReal) + 1)*(10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) := by gcongr; grind [le_of_lt]
    _ = _ := by ring
  intro n; simp; calc
    _ ≤ (x * 10^n) * (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) := by gcongr; grind
    _ = x := by rw [mul_assoc, ←rpow_natCast, ←rpow_add]; simp; norm_num

name: NNRealDecimal.not_inj
statement: theorem NNRealDecimal.not_inj : (1:NNReal) = (mk 1 fun _ ↦ 0) ∧ (1:NNReal) = (mk 0 fun _ ↦ 9)
proof:
:= by
  
  simp [toNNReal]
  have := (mk 0 fun _ ↦ 9).toNNReal_conv.tendsto_sum_tsum_nat
  simp at this
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique _ this
  convert_to Filter.atTop.Tendsto (fun n:ℕ ↦ 1 - (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ)) (nhds 1) using 2 with n
  . induction' n with n hn
    . simp
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hn, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, neg_add']
    have : (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ) = 10^(-n-1:ℝ) * 10 := by
      rw [←rpow_add_one]; simp; norm_num
    simp [this, ←coe_inj]
    rw [NNReal.coe_sub, NNReal.coe_sub]
    . suffices h : ∀ c a : ℝ, c = 9 → 1 - a * 10 + c * a = 1 - a by apply h; norm_cast
      grind
    . apply rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos; norm_num; linarith
    rw [←rpow_add_one]
    apply rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos; norm_num; linarith; norm_num
  convert Filter.Tendsto.const_sub (f := fun n:ℕ ↦ (10:NNReal)^(-n:ℝ)) (c := 0) 1 _; simp
  convert tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (show (1/10:NNReal) < 1 by bound) with n
  rw [←rpow_natCast, one_div, inv_rpow, rpow_neg]

name: RealDecimal.surj
statement: theorem RealDecimal.surj (x:ℝ) : ∃ d:RealDecimal, x = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := le_or_gt 0 x
  . choose d hd using NNRealDecimal.surj (x.toNNReal); use pos d; simp [←hd, h]
  . choose d hd using NNRealDecimal.surj ((-x).toNNReal); use neg d; simp [←hd, show 0 ≤ -x by linarith]

name: Real.eq_lim_of_rat
statement: theorem Real.eq_lim_of_rat (α:ℝ) : ∃ q: ℕ → ℚ, ((fun n ↦ (q n:ℝ)):Sequence).TendsTo α
proof:
:= by
  choose q hcauchy hLIM using (Chapter5.Real.equivR.symm α).eq_lim; use q
  apply lim_eq_LIM at hcauchy
  simp only [←hLIM, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcauchy
  convert hcauchy; aesop

name: Real.rpow_eq_lim_ratPow
proof:
:=
   ratPow_lim_uniq hx (eq_lim_of_rat α).choose_spec hq

name: Real.ratPow_tendsto_rpow
proof:
:= by
  rw [lim_eq]
  exact ⟨ ratPow_continuous hx hq, (rpow_eq_lim_ratPow hx hq).symm ⟩

name: Real.rpow_of_rat_eq_ratPow
statement:
lemma Real.rpow_of_rat_eq_ratPow {x:ℝ} (hx: x > 0) {q: ℚ} :
  rpow x (q:ℝ) = x^(q:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  convert rpow_eq_lim_ratPow hx (α := q) (lim_of_const _)
  exact (lim_eq.mp (lim_of_const _)).2.symm

name: Real.ratPow_add
statement: theorem Real.ratPow_add {x:ℝ} (hx: x > 0) (q r:ℝ) : rpow x (q+r) = rpow x q * rpow x r
proof:
:= by
  choose q' hq' using eq_lim_of_rat q
  choose r' hr' using eq_lim_of_rat r
  have hq'r' := tendsTo_add hq' hr'
  rw [add_coe] at hq'r'
  convert_to ((fun n ↦ ((q' n + r' n:ℚ):ℝ)):Sequence).TendsTo (q + r) at hq'r'
  . aesop
  have h1 := ratPow_continuous hx hq'
  have h2 := ratPow_continuous hx hr'
  rw [rpow_eq_lim_ratPow hx hq', rpow_eq_lim_ratPow hx hr', rpow_eq_lim_ratPow hx hq'r', ←(lim_mul h1 h2).2, mul_coe]
  rcongr n; rw [←rpow_add]; simp; linarith

name: Sequence.equiv_example
statement:
lemma Sequence.equiv_example :
  
  
  Equiv (fun n:ℕ ↦ (1:ℚ)+10^(-(n:ℤ)-1)) (fun n:ℕ ↦ (1:ℚ)-10^(-(n:ℤ)-1))
proof:
:= by
  set a := fun n:ℕ ↦ (1:ℚ)+10^(-(n:ℤ)-1)
  set b := fun n:ℕ ↦ (1:ℚ)-10^(-(n:ℤ)-1)
  rw [equiv_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hab (n:ℕ) : |a n - b n| = 2 * 10 ^ (-(n:ℤ)-1) := calc
    _ = |((1:ℚ) + (10:ℚ)^(-(n:ℤ)-1)) - ((1:ℚ) - (10:ℚ)^(-(n:ℤ)-1))| := rfl
    _ = |2 * (10:ℚ)^(-(n:ℤ)-1)| := by ring_nf
    _ = _ := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  have hab' (N:ℕ) : ∀ n ≥ N, |a n - b n| ≤ 2 * 10 ^(-(N:ℤ)-1) := by
    intro n hn; rw [hab n]; gcongr; norm_num
  have hN : ∃ N:ℕ, 2 * (10:ℚ) ^(-(N:ℤ)-1) ≤ ε := by
    have hN' (N:ℕ) : 2 * (10:ℚ)^(-(N:ℤ)-1) ≤ 2/(N+1) := calc
      _ = 2 / (10:ℚ)^(N+1) := by
        field_simp
        simp [←Section_4_3.pow_eq_zpow, ←zpow_add₀ (show 10 ≠ (0:ℚ) by norm_num)]
      _ ≤ _ := by
        gcongr
        apply le_trans _ (pow_le_pow_left₀ (show 0 ≤ (2:ℚ) by norm_num)
          (show (2:ℚ) ≤ 10 by norm_num) _)
        convert Nat.cast_le.mpr (Section_4_3.two_pow_geq (N+1)) using 1 <;> try infer_instance
        all_goals simp
    choose N hN using exists_nat_gt (2 / ε)
    refine ⟨ N, (hN' N).trans ?_ ⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hN
    grind [mul_comm]
  choose N hN using hN; use N; intro n hn
  linarith [hab' N n hn]
